'''Vitley''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Working as an [[Detective/Legends|investigator]], she was based on the Republic's [[Carrick Station]].
